description: Import this repository's structure into a VibeMap project. Extracts the facts locally, then sends only the facts: table, column, foreign-key, policy and route definitions with their file paths. File contents never leave your machine. VibeMap turns them into the schema, access rules and one page per route, each linked to its file, and records a structural map of the repository (file paths only) if the project has none yet. Re-running on unchanged code writes nothing. Available on Pro and higher plans.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the repository (defaults to the directory the server runs in)

name: vibemap_import_facts
